[B]with my guitar, [F#]never goes
[G#m]away [D#m]She is with
[E]me through the night [B]And in the mor-
[F#]ning she stays I wash away
[B]like yesterday [F#]Float down the
[G#m]stream through all my ways [D#m]Since she a-
[E]ccompanies my [B]steps in all my
[F#]days She has

[Pre-Chorus]
[E]six strings that I know [F#]Just how to work
[G#m]and how to play We speak a lan-
[E]guage of our own [F#]Every
[G#m]minute of the day We get along
[E]into the song [F#]I find her
[G#m]heart and I make it strong And she backs me
[E]up when everyone has [G#m]gone awa
[F#]y She sings to me

[B]  [F#]
[G#m]  [D#m]
[E]  [B]
[F#]She sings to me
[B]  [F#]
[G#m]  [D#m]

[Verse 2]
[B]very far [F#]Stays around
[G#m]no matter what [D#m]I am do-
[E]ing She is [B]there for me
[F#]I know that she
[B]don't know the words [F#]I don't care,
[G#m]I kinda like [D#m]it Less the tal-
[E]king, a little more [B]the melody
[F#]She reaches out

[Pre-Chorus]
[E]without a touch [F#]She knows that
[G#m]whatever I love Ends up
[E]broken in the past [F#]and out the door
[G#m]I have
[E]broken her before [F#]I let her fall
[G#m]onto the floor I call it cha-
[E]racter and I [G#m]love her more
